project_type: Full-stack web app: React+Vite frontend (Vercel) + Node.js/Express backend (Render) + Supabase Postgres via Prisma
language: JavaScript (ES modules, JSDoc comments, no TypeScript required)
build_system: Two independent package.json files: server/ uses Node.js ESM, client/ uses Vite. Root has no package.json. All commands run from their respective subdirectory.
test_framework: None required — verify by running the dev server and checking for zero runtime errors. Integration smoke-checks noted per FEAT.
build_command: server: `node server.js` (start) or `npm run dev` (nodemon). client: `npm run build` (Vite production build) or `npm run dev` (Vite dev server).
test_command: server: `node --input-type=module < scripts/seed.js` to verify DB seed. client: `npm run build` — exits 0 means no compile errors.
verification_instructions: 1. From server/: `npm install` then `npx prisma generate` then `npx prisma migrate dev` then `node src/prisma/seed.js` then `npm run dev` — server should log 'Server running on port 5000'. 2. From client/: `npm install` then `npm run build` — Vite should exit 0 with no errors. 3. GET http://localhost:5000/health should return {status:'ok'}.
snapshot_or_generated_files: server/src/prisma/client (generated by `npx prisma generate`). Never commit node_modules or .env files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell workspace. All paths use backslashes locally but forward slashes in code. Never expose .env values. Supabase is DB host only — connect via DATABASE_URL in .env. Paystack test keys in dev. JWT in httpOnly cookies. CORS locked to FRONTEND_URL env var.
contribution_requirements: All money values stored as integers in kobo (multiply naira by 100). Never use floats for money. Wrap every money movement in a Prisma $transaction. Ledger entries are append-only — no updates or deletes. Every admin route must verify role=ADMIN server-side. Rate-limit all auth endpoints.
key_patterns: Greenfield project — patterns are defined here: Controllers handle HTTP, services handle business logic and DB. All routes in server/src/routes/ imported in server.js. Frontend pages in client/src/pages/{public,member,admin}/. Shared UI in client/src/components/ui/. API calls go through client/src/lib/api.js (axios instance with credentials:include). AuthContext wraps the app. React Router v6 with protected route wrappers. Tailwind + CSS variables for the design system. Framer Motion for all animations.
directory_structure: Root: README.md, .agents/tasks/. server/: Express API, Prisma ORM, cron jobs, services. server/src/: controllers/, routes/, middleware/, services/, jobs/, utils/, prisma/. client/: Vite+React SPA. client/src/: pages/{public,member,admin}/, components/{layout,ui,forms}/, hooks/, context/, lib/, styles/. client/public/: static assets.
